text:
zoe_cs: Luna (Sable Labs) opened a beta enrollment ticket: they hit the preview seat cap when adding new evaluators and now some accounts show "awaiting invite". They're worried this will impact the trial conversion conversation next week. Can we coordinate a quick lift + short enablement?

mike_onboard: Hi! Do we have org ID and whether they used self-serve invites or SCIM?

zoe_cs: ORG SBL-9002, they used self-serve invites but also added a few by SCIM. Customer says 5 invites stuck in pending.

sanjay_eng: Running `redwood-admin seats list --org SBL-9002 --status pending` now. If cap bug, could be our preview cap enforcement run firing twice.

ci-bot: ci 1745550010: nightly-cap-check job finished for SBL-9002; quota=50 used=50

sanjay_eng: Found race: two simultaneous seat-claim workers processed invites; our dedupe missed one batch. I can lift cap temporarily and reprocess queue. ETA 20m.

mike_onboard: I'll hold an enablement quick-drop at 11:00am PT (15m) to walk the new evaluators through access, share best practices for prompt sets, and record a 5min clip they can forward to their POC. I'll include a 2-question feedback pulse.

luna_customer: 11:00am PT works. We'd like the recording + a one-pager about managing seats and quota requests. Also curious if this incident changes our renewal tier recommendation.

claire_success: I'll flag this as a medium renewal risk in SFDC and log the incident notes. If we resolve fast and deliver a great enablement, we can downgrade risk. Will coordinate follow-up 48h after session.

sanjay_eng: Temp action: `redwood-admin quotas update --org SBL-9002 --override 60 --reason "beta enroll emergency"` then requeue pending invites: `redwood-admin invites requeue --org SBL-9002`

ci-bot: job 1745550065: quotas updated; invites requeued (5 invites).

luna_customer: Invites just came through  thanks! Joining 11:00 session.

mike_onboard: Session link: https://meet.redwood.ai/11am-sable-quickstart. I'll record and add the one-pager after. Agenda in thread: 1) confirm seats + roles, 2) short walkthrough of trial limits & how to request more, 3) sample prompt checklist, 4) 2-question feedback.

zoe_cs: I'll send the remediation note and feedback link to the broader stakeholder list after the session. Also adding the enablement recording to the account playbook.

claire_success: Follow-up plan: 1) Check feedback score within 24h, 2) If score <4, schedule 30m tailored session, 3) Review renewal tier with AM. I'll paste SFDC link when done.

sanjay_eng: Patch to seat-claim dedupe landed: `git pr 4223` merged; will monitor metrics for an hour. Logs: 
```
2024-04-12T15:09:03Z seat-claim: dedupe hit for SBL-9002 batch-7
2024-04-12T15:09:05Z quota: override applied by sanjay_eng
2024-04-12T15:10:12Z invites: 5 requeued -> delivered
```

ci-bot: monitor 1745550120: seat-claim error rate back to baseline (<0.1%).

luna_customer: Recording received and we shared the one-pager internally. Feedback form submitted: score 5, comment "fast response, helpful checklist". Thanks team!

zoe_cs: Awesome  I'll mark this thread resolved and attach the playback + feedback snippet to the account record. Great cross-team work :tada:
